bank.usage:
*🏦 Cosmos Central Bank*

Available commands:
• *.bank register* - Open a new bank account
• *.bank balance* - View account statement & balance
• *.bank deposit <amount>* - Deposit cash to bank
• *.bank withdraw <amount>* - Withdraw cash from bank
• *.bank transfer <account> <amount>* - Transfer to another account

💡 *Tip:* Type .menu tutorial bank for a step-by-step guide.

Available commands:
• *.loan apply <amount> [collateral_name]* - Apply for a loan with AI assessment

• *.loan status* - View your active loan and repayment deadline

tutorial.step1_body:
• By default, NSFW features are DISABLED in group chats.
• Only Group Admins and the Bot Owner can enable or disable it:
  - Enable: `{{prefix}}on nsfw` (or `{{prefix}}on hentai`)
  - Disable: `{{prefix}}off nsfw` (or `{{prefix}}off hentai`)
• In private chat (DM), it is enabled by default without needing activation.
tutorial.step2_body:
• Quick Random: Type `{{prefix}}r34` (with no arguments) to instantly fetch a curated random video.
• Specific Tags: Type `{{prefix}}r34 <tags>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}r34 genshin_impact`).
• Multi-tag: Separate multiple tags with spaces.
tutorial.step3_body:
• Anti-AI Art Filter: Content generated by AI (Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, NovelAI, etc.) is automatically stripped.
• Videos Only: Static images and GIFs are blocked.
• Duration Filter: Only videos between 15 and 30 seconds are delivered.
tutorial.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Type `{{prefix}}menu` to return to the main command categories.

bank.summary: Account opening, deposits, withdrawals & secure transfers
bank.step1_body:
• Type `{{prefix}}bank open` or `{{prefix}}bank register` to open your Central Bank account.
• Requires an active Virtual ID (`{{prefix}}idcard register`).
• Check your official bank statement and 0.5% daily interest via `{{prefix}}bank statement`.
bank.step2_body:
• Deposit cash: `{{prefix}}bank deposit <amount>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}bank deposit 500000` or `{{prefix}}bank deposit all`).
• Withdraw cash: `{{prefix}}bank withdraw <amount>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}bank withdraw 250000` or `{{prefix}}bank withdraw all`).
• Money kept in the bank vault earns interest daily at 00:00 UTC.
bank.step3_body:
• Initiate transfer: `{{prefix}}transfer <target> <amount>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}transfer @user 100000`).
• Review the fee (`Rp2.500`) and details, then reply with `confirm` within 3 minutes.
• Abort anytime during confirmation by typing `{{prefix}}cancel`.
bank.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Use `{{prefix}}cancel` at any time to abort an ongoing transfer session.

loan.summary: Credit score checks, AI loan underwriting & repayment
loan.step1_body:
• Inspect credit tier: Type `{{prefix}}loan info` or `{{prefix}}loan status`.
• Score ranges from 0 to 1000 based on your last 30 days of transactions and activity.
• Higher scores unlock lower interest rates (2%–15%) and larger borrowing limits.
loan.step2_body:
• Apply: `{{prefix}}loan apply <amount> [collateral]` (e.g. `{{prefix}}loan apply 5000000` or `{{prefix}}loan apply 20000000 Luxury Apartment`).
• Cosmos AI Underwriter evaluates your score, collateral, and cash flow in real-time.
• Reply `confirm` within 3 minutes to disburse the funds into your bank account.
loan.step3_body:
• Repay loan: `{{prefix}}loan pay <amount|all>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}loan pay 1000000` or `{{prefix}}loan pay all`).
• Pay before the due date to boost your credit rating.
• ⚠️ *Warning:* Defaulting will freeze your bank account (`FROZEN`) and liquidate pawned inventory/property assets automatically.
loan.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Maintain a high credit score by transacting and playing games actively before applying.

job.summary: Career joining, driver licensing & dynamic work shifts
job.step1_body:
• Browse jobs: Type `{{prefix}}job list` to see available careers, base wages, and shift cooldowns.
• Join a job: `{{prefix}}job join <job_id>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}job join driver`).
• Apply for licenses: Type `{{prefix}}apply license` to obtain specialized driver/operator permits.
job.step2_body:
• Certain jobs require specific equipment in your inventory (e.g. Courier requires a Motorcycle from `.shop`).
• Purchase required tools using `{{prefix}}buy <item_id>` from the catalog.
• Inspect your active equipment using `{{prefix}}inventory`.
job.step3_body:
• Perform shift: Type `{{prefix}}work` to execute your job duty and earn wages.
• Payouts scale dynamically with the global `EconomyMultiplier`.
• Wait out the cooldown period before beginning your next shift.
job.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Work regularly and upgrade your license to unlock higher-paying executive careers.

casino.summary: Slots, coinflip, dice rolls, daily rewards & vault banking
casino.step1_body:
• Check funds: `{{prefix}}balance` (or `{{prefix}}saldo`) to view wallet and bank funds.
• Claim free coins: `{{prefix}}daily` every 24 hours to receive bonus Rupiah.
• Lock profits: `{{prefix}}vault deposit <amount>` to safeguard winnings from wagers.
casino.step2_body:
• Slot Machine: `{{prefix}}slot <amount|all>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}slot 50000`). Match symbols for up to 20x multipliers!
• Coinflip: `{{prefix}}coinflip <amount> <heads|tails>` for a 50/50 double-or-nothing bet.
• Dice Roll: `{{prefix}}dice <amount>` to roll high against the house.
casino.step3_body:
• Fever Time: Activate or view server-wide jackpot multiplier events via `{{prefix}}fevertime`.
• Group Ranks: Type `{{prefix}}top` to view local chat wealth rankings.
• Global Ranks: Type `{{prefix}}topglobal` to see Cosmos-wide top players.
casino.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Store your profits in `{{prefix}}vault` to avoid accidentally losing them on big bets.

roulette.summary: Multiplayer shotgun showdown, tactical items & bluffing
roulette.step1_body:
• Create lobby: `{{prefix}}creategame <bet>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}creategame 100000`).
• Join game: Opponent types `{{prefix}}joingame` to match the bet amount.
• Start match: Room host types `{{prefix}}startgame` once players are ready.
• Cancel lobby: Type `{{prefix}}cancel` before the game begins to refund all wagers.
roulette.step2_body:
• Shotgun chambers contain a randomized mix of LIVE and BLANK shells.
• Shoot opponent: `{{prefix}}shoot @opponent` to inflict damage if the shell is live.
• Shoot self: `{{prefix}}shoot self` — if the shell is blank, you skip damage AND retain your turn!
roulette.step3_body:
• Use items: `{{prefix}}use <item_name>` on your turn.
• 🔍 Magnifying Glass: Inspect current chamber shell type.
• 🔪 Knife: Saw off shotgun barrel for double damage on your next live shot.
• 🍺 Beer: Rack the shotgun and eject current shell safely.
• ⛓️ Handcuffs: Lock opponent down to skip their upcoming turn.
roulette.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Tactical risk pays off: shooting yourself with a blank shell keeps momentum on your side.

subbot.summary: 8-digit WhatsApp pairing, independent uptime & custom AI keys
subbot.step1_body:
• Initiate pairing: In private chat with the bot, send `{{prefix}}subbot <phone_number>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}subbot 6281234567890`).
• Cosmos generates an official 8-digit WhatsApp pairing code (e.g. `ABCD-1234`).
• Abort anytime: Type `{{prefix}}cancel` to immediately abort an ongoing pairing request.
subbot.step2_body:
• Open WhatsApp on your target phone.
• Navigate to Settings > Linked Devices > Link a Device > Link with phone number instead.
• Enter the 8-digit code within 2 minutes to authorize the session.
• Once authenticated, your number becomes an autonomous Cosmos bot running 24/7.
subbot.step3_body:
• Custom AI Key: Set your private Groq API key via `{{prefix}}config groq_key <key>`.
• Language settings: Configure sub-bot language via `{{prefix}}setlang <id|en>`.
• Disconnect sub-bot: Type `{{prefix}}subbot stop` to terminate the linked session safely.
subbot.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Always configure private API keys in DM to avoid leaking secrets in group chats.

idcard.summary: Civil registry wizard, Virtual ID Card & cancellation controls
idcard.step1_title: 1️⃣ WHY YOU NEED A VIRTUAL ID
idcard.step1_body:
• Virtual ID Card (`IDCard`) is the mandatory gateway for the Cosmos civil ecosystem.
• Required to open Central Bank accounts (`{{prefix}}bank`) and apply for jobs (`{{prefix}}job`).
• Prevents identity spoofing and establishes permanent economic credit history.
idcard.step2_body:
• Start registration: Type `{{prefix}}idcard register` (or `{{prefix}}ktp daftar`).
• Interactive prompt asks for: Full Name, Age (min 15), Gender, and Domicile City.
• Cosmos renders an official graphical ID Card badge upon completion.
idcard.step3_body:
• View card: Type `{{prefix}}idcard` (or `{{prefix}}ktp`) to inspect your digital card.
• View profile: Type `{{prefix}}profile` to inspect comprehensive user statistics.
• Cancel prompt: Type `{{prefix}}cancel` at any question step to abort registration.
idcard.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Type `{{prefix}}cancel` at any point during registration to exit immediately.

sticker.summary: Static & animated stickers, Brat typography & Sticker.ly packs
sticker.step1_body:
• Static Sticker: Send an image with caption `{{prefix}}s` (or quote an image with `{{prefix}}s`).
• Animated Sticker: Send a video or GIF under 10 seconds with caption `{{prefix}}s`.
• Quoted Sticker: Reply to any image or short video with `{{prefix}}s` to convert it.
sticker.step2_body:
• Static Brat: Type `{{prefix}}brat <text>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}brat hello world`).
• Animated Brat: Type `{{prefix}}brat -a <text>` to generate animated typing effect stickers.
• Monospace support: Wrap text with backticks (`text`) to preserve exact formatting.
sticker.step3_body:
• Search packs: Type `{{prefix}}stickerly <query>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}stickerly cat meme`).
• Cosmos searches Sticker.ly and delivers high quality stickers directly into the chat.
sticker.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Keep animated videos under 10 seconds and 5 MB to ensure smooth WhatsApp delivery.

downloader.summary: TikTok no-watermark, YouTube Audio/Video, Pinterest & Telegram bridge
downloader.step1_body:
• TikTok: `{{prefix}}tiktokdl <url>` — automatically downloads HD video without watermark.
• Pinterest: `{{prefix}}pinterestdl <url>` — downloads high resolution photos and pin videos.
• Auto Downloader: Enable automatic URL sniffing in chat via `{{prefix}}autodl on`.
downloader.step2_body:
• YouTube: `{{prefix}}ytdl <url>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}ytdl https://youtu.be/...`).
• Supports downloading video (MP4) and audio (MP3).
• Files are capped at 50 MB to comply with WhatsApp transmission limits.
downloader.step3_body:
• Download: `{{prefix}}telegramdl <post_url>` (e.g. `https://t.me/c/12345/678`).
• Session management: Register private session keys via `{{prefix}}tgadd <session_string>`.
• View active sessions: Type `{{prefix}}tglist` or remove them with `{{prefix}}tgdel`.
downloader.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Enable `{{prefix}}autodl on` in your group to download videos without typing commands.

ai.summary: Sara conversational AI, voice note Whisper STT & group autocorrect
ai.prereq: 📌 *Prerequisites:* Text prompt or quoted audio recording
ai.step1_body:
• Direct Chat: Type `{{prefix}}sara <query>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}sara explain quantum computing`).
• Sara acts as your intelligent companion with contextual memory and tool execution.
• Contact Nonces: Sara securely maps and accesses saved phonebook contacts via `{{prefix}}contact`.
ai.step2_body:
• Transcribe audio: Reply to any voice note (PTT) or audio file with `{{prefix}}stt`.
• Uses Groq Whisper API for ultra-fast, accurate bilingual transcription.
• Handles Indonesian regional accents, slang, and English terminology seamlessly.
ai.step3_body:
• Group Autocorrect: `{{prefix}}startautocorrection` activates AI typo fixes.
• Stop Autocorrect: `{{prefix}}stopautocorrection` turns off real-time message editing.
• Toggle: Use `{{prefix}}toggleautocorrection` to flip state quickly in group chats.
ai.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Reply to long voice notes with `{{prefix}}stt` to read transcripts in seconds.

market.summary: Property catalog, market ticks, inventory management & asset trading
market.step1_body:
• Market Overview: Type `{{prefix}}market` to inspect global economy trends and price indices.
• Property Catalog: Type `{{prefix}}catalog` (or `{{prefix}}shop`) to browse properties and items.
• View asset tiers: From Motorbikes and Studio Apartments to Luxury Penthouses.
market.step2_body:
• Buy asset: Type `{{prefix}}buy <item_id>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}buy apartment`).
• Funds are deducted from your wallet or bank balance.
• View owned assets: Type `{{prefix}}inventory` (or `{{prefix}}inv`) to inspect active properties and work tools.
market.step3_body:
• Sell property: Type `{{prefix}}sell <item_id>` to liquidate assets for quick cash.
• Market Appreciation: Property values fluctuate over time based on macroeconomic ticks.
• Loan Collateral: Owned properties can be pledged for larger bank loans (`{{prefix}}loan apply`).
market.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Hold high-tier properties as collateral to unlock maximum borrowing capacity in loans.

music.summary: Audio playback in chat, song search & high quality MP3 streams
music.prereq: 📌 *Prerequisites:* Song Title, Artist or YouTube Query
music.step1_body:
• Play music: Type `{{prefix}}play <title>` (e.g. `{{prefix}}play Bohemian Rhapsody`).
• Cosmos searches YouTube, downloads audio stream, and sends high quality audio.
• Audio files are tagged with song title, artist, and album thumbnail.
music.step2_body:
• Track Selection: If multiple songs match, choose by typing the number (1-5).
• Cancel search: Type `{{prefix}}cancel` to dismiss song selection at any time.
• High Quality: Direct YouTube Music audio streaming.
music.step3_body:
• Reply Playback: Reply to any message containing a song title with `{{prefix}}play` to download it directly.
• Direct Links: Paste YouTube links to fetch audio streams instantly.
music.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Use `{{prefix}}play <title>` in any chat to stream music instantly.

moderation.summary: NSFW activation rules, Auto-DL toggles, view-once extractors & lang
moderation.step1_body:
• By default, NSFW features are DISABLED in group chats.
• Only Group Admins and the Bot Owner can enable or disable it:
  - Enable: `{{prefix}}on nsfw` (or `{{prefix}}on hentai`)
  - Disable: `{{prefix}}off nsfw` (or `{{prefix}}off hentai`)
• In private chat (DM), it is enabled by default without needing activation.
moderation.step2_body:
• Auto Downloader: Toggle automatic link downloads using `{{prefix}}autodl <on|off>`.
• Group Language: Set chat language preference using `{{prefix}}setgrouplang <id|en>`.
• User Language: Set personal language in DM using `{{prefix}}setlang <id|en>`.
moderation.step3_body:
• Read View-Once: Reply to any View-Once photo or video with `{{prefix}}rvo` to reveal it.
• Quote Inspector: Reply to any message with `{{prefix}}quoted` to inspect raw metadata.
• Profile Photo: Get full resolution user avatar via `{{prefix}}getprofilephoto @user`.
moderation.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Type `{{prefix}}menu` to return to the main command categories.

system.summary: System diagnostics, group admission, plans & quotas
system.step1_body:
• Diagnostics: Type `{{prefix}}system_info` (or `{{prefix}}sysinfo`) to check memory, CPU, and Baileys socket uptime.
• Catalog check: Type `{{prefix}}menu all` to view all active tools registered in the runtime.
system.step2_body:
• Group Admission: Cosmos operates in whitelisted mode for high stability.
• Verify user: Type `{{prefix}}verify` to check admission eligibility.
• Whitelist group: Admins/Owners register active groups via `{{prefix}}whitelist`.
system.step3_body:
• Check Plan: Type `{{prefix}}myplan` to inspect your active subscription tier and limits.
• Quota Usage: Type `{{prefix}}quota` to view remaining daily query limits.
• Manage Plan: Type `{{prefix}}sub` to upgrade or renew subscription tiers.
system.footer: 💡 *Tip:* Type `{{prefix}}help <command>` for deep parameter inspections on any tool.
